name: overclock
description: Overclock — Claude Code plugins that run your model past spec.

plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Stop losing your working state. Warm session resume (handoffs with git-anchored drift detection) plus lessons that persist across sessions — corrections stop evaporating, failed approaches stop being retried.

plugins.name: learning-loop
plugins.description: A self-improvement loop for your agent. Corrections ("no, use pnpm, not npm") and diagnosed failures become durable, evidence-counted lessons in .ai/memory/LESSONS.md, deduplicated by meaning and surfaced in later sessions so the same mistakes stop recurring. Standalone — no session-handoff needed; the ledger format is compatible with session-memory if you run both.

plugins.name: natural-writing
plugins.description: Make AI drafts read like a human wrote them. A prose writing/editing skill for blog posts, articles, and essays that strips the tells which mark text as AI-generated (em-dashes, words like 'delve'/'leverage', uniform sentence rhythm, bot scaffolding) so you can use AI without rewriting everything by hand. Preserves quotes verbatim and stays silent on code, commit messages, and one-line edits.
